source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Provide the date and time of the inspection.
3. Note down the vehicle make, model, VIN (Vehicle Identification Number), and registration number.
4. Clearly indicate that the brake test was performed.
5. Describe the testing method used (e.g., road test, computerized brake testing equipment, roller brake tester).
6. Document the conditions of the test (e.g., road surface condition, ambient temperature, tire pressure, load of the vehicle).
7. Mention the specific sections of the brake system that failed.
8. Describe the symptoms observed: excessive pedal travel, spongy brake pedal, pulling to one side, unusual noises, brake fade, extended stopping distance, etc.
9. Note if ABS (Anti-lock Braking System) light or other warning lights are on.
10. For each brake component that fails, write down:
